name: EVN AG
summary: EVN AG provides energy and environmental services in Austria, Bulgaria, North Macedonia, Croatia, Germany, and Albania. The company operates through Energy, Generation, Networks, South East Europe, Environmental, and All Other segments. It is involved in energy generation; operation of distribution networks; production and supply of electricity, natural gas, and heat to end customers, as well as investment activities. The company also offers environmental services, such as supply of drinking water; procures, trades, markets, and sells electricity, natural gas, and primary energy carriers to end customers and wholesale markets.
